annotation.title_en: Government Takes Proactive Steps to Address Ethical and Legal Implications of Artificial Intelligence
annotation.summary_en: Malaysian Ministry of Digital press release (23 Oct 2024) reporting the Digital Minister's parliamentary reply on government steps addressing AI's ethical, legal, economic and social implications, including the forthcoming National AI Office (NAIO) and MOSTI's AI Governance and Ethics (AIGE) guidelines of September 2024, based on seven principles.
key_provisions_or_claims: National AI Office (NAIO) to be launched by end of 2024 to position Malaysia as a regional AI player
NAIO received 1,254 applications for key leadership posts
MOSTI launched AIGE guidelines on 20 September 2024 based on seven principles
AIGE covers users, policymakers, designers, and technology providers
Guidelines aim to uphold social and ethical values and human rights
